title: a11y command always-print resolved target full-path grap spec
desc: MANDATE for every a11y command processor (invoke click press inspect screenshot --target etc) in WKAppBot.CLI: must print the resolved target node full-path grap on stdout regardless of the input grap argument shape (literal wildcard or partial), and regardless of action success or failure exit code.
steps: Folder: D:/GitHub/WKAppBot/csharp/src/WKAppBot.CLI/Commands/ contains A11yCommand.cs and related action processors

MANDATE: every code path that resolves a target node via grap pattern matching must emit one line Console.WriteLine Ansi.TargetLine pound TARGET space resolved-leaf-grap on stdout BEFORE the action call (invoke click etc)
The resolved leaf grap is the AppendFocusPath result against the matched node Handle not the input argument that may be a wildcard or partial
Must fire even when --force is used and even when action fails or returns nonzero exit code
If multiple actions resolve nodes in a single command emit one TARGET line per resolved node
Verification yt_assistant log should show invoked equals plus full path grap after first successful skip-button match
